title: Pink Pearls & Heels and Men Wear Pink Raise More Than $55,000 for the American Cancer Society
excerpt: Two Laredo breast cancer awareness fundraisers wrapped up Monday, raising more than $55,000 for the American Cancer Society to help local patients with screenings, lodging and transportation.
content:
Two Laredo breast cancer awareness fundraisers wrapped up Monday, raising more than $55,000 for the American Cancer Society, according to KGNS.

Pink Pearls & Heels, now in its fourth year, is organized by Webb County Sheriff Martin Cuellar and his wife, Imelda Cuellar. Men Wear Pink, in its second year, is put on by the Laredo Heat Soccer Club.

Sheriff Cuellar called the event “a huge success” and noted a great turnout of supporters. He added that his mother was a breast cancer survivor.

The money raised helps cover the costs of cancer screenings, lodging and transportation for local patients, according to the report.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 17, 2026.
